title: Add search/filter by text across all fields
description: Implement fuzzy text search that matches across title, description, assignee, and labels. Show results in real-time as user types in the search bar.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Should we use fzf-style fuzzy matching or simple substring search? Fuzzy is more forgiving but harder to implement.

title: Performance: lazy-load issue descriptions
description: Currently all issue descriptions are loaded upfront which is slow for large databases. Defer loading full description text until the detail screen is opened.

title: Implement inline issue creation form
description: Add a form screen for creating new issues. Fields: title, type, priority, assignee, description. Validate required fields and show confirmation before creating.

title: Design and implement TCSS theme system
description: Create a cohesive color theme using Textual CSS. Support dark mode by default with sensible defaults for status colors, priority badges, and selection highlights.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Draft color palette posted in the design doc. Using catppuccin-mocha as inspiration but with higher contrast for accessibility.

title: Table rows flash white on rapid scroll
description: When scrolling quickly through the issue table using j/k keys, rows briefly flash white before rendering their correct background color. Likely a Textual render cycle issue.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Reproduced on macOS Terminal.app and iTerm2. Does NOT happen in kitty. Might be a terminal-specific refresh issue.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: This seems related to Textual issue #4521. The workaround is to set a 1-frame delay on row highlight updates.

title: Handle missing or corrupt database gracefully
description: App crashes with unhandled exception when .beads directory is missing or database file is corrupt. Should show a friendly error screen with recovery suggestions.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Crash log attached. The traceback shows sqlite3.DatabaseError when the WAL file is locked by another process.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: We should add a retry with exponential backoff for transient lock errors. Maybe 3 retries with 50/100/200ms delays.

title: Epic: Full write support from TUI
description: Enable creating, editing, and closing issues directly from the TUI without dropping to the command line. Includes inline editing, create form, and status updates.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Breaking this into phases: phase 1 is status updates and close, phase 2 is full create/edit. Let's not boil the ocean.

title: Status transitions should respect workflow rules
description: Validate status transitions (e.g., cannot go directly from closed to in_progress without reopening). Show user-friendly error messages for invalid transitions.

title: Priority picker modal widget
description: Create a modal popup for changing issue priority. Show all priority levels (P0-P4) with color coding and keyboard shortcuts for quick selection.

title: Build detail screen for single issue view
description: Full-screen detail view showing all issue fields: title, description, status, priority, assignee, dependencies, comments. Should support scrolling for long descriptions.

title: Add keyboard navigation and vim-style bindings
description: Implement vim-style keybindings (j/k for up/down, gg/G for top/bottom, / for search) alongside standard arrow key navigation.

title: Implement issue list table widget
description: Create the main DataTable widget that displays issues in a scrollable table with columns for ID, title, status, priority, assignee, and type.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: DataTable performance is fine up to ~500 rows. Beyond that we should look into virtual scrolling.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Added column sorting by clicking headers. Priority sorts numerically (P0 first), not alphabetically.

title: Set up Textual app skeleton and main entry point
description: Bootstrap the Textual application with App subclass, CSS loading, and CLI entry point via click or argparse.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Went with Textual 0.86 for the base framework. CSS hot-reload is working nicely during development.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Should we pin the Textual version or use >= constraint? I've seen breaking changes between minor releases.

title: Add live-reload when issue database changes
description: Watch the .beads database file for changes and automatically refresh the issue list. Use filesystem events (inotify/kqueue) with debouncing to avoid excessive reloads.

comments.author: Demo User
comments.text: Using watchfiles library with kqueue on macOS. Had to add 200ms debounce to avoid reload storms during bd batch operations.

title: Connect bd client library for reading issues
description: Integrate with the bd Go binary or SQLite database to read issue data. Handle database discovery, connection pooling, and error recovery.

title: Add dependency graph visualization
description: Render a visual dependency graph using box-drawing characters or a tree view. Show blocking and blocked-by relationships with color coding for status.

title: CI: add automated TUI screenshot tests
description: Set up Textual snapshot testing in CI. Capture screenshots of key screens (list, detail, filter modal) and compare against golden files to catch visual regressions.

title: Implement filter bar with status/priority/assignee filters
description: Add a filter bar widget at the top of the list view. Support filtering by status, priority, assignee, and type. Filters should be composable and show active filter count.
